spans.s: भू-उत्तम n. gold.
भू-तल n. the surface of the earth.
भूतृण m. a kind of fragrant grass.
भूत (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Become, produced, formed, R.v.34, Sis.ii.24; 2. mixed; 3. true, really happened; 4. similar, like; 5. proper, fit; 6. obtained; 7. past, gone, (pp. of भू q.v.).
भूत (II) m. 1. A son, a child; 2. an epithet of Śiva; 3. the dark half of a lunar month.

भूत (III) n. 1. A creature, an animal, a living being, भूतानुकंपा तव चेत् R.ii.48, Bg.x.39; 2. the spirit of a deceased person, a ghost, an imp; 3. an element of creation (they are पृथ्वी, अप्, तेजस्, वायु and आकाश), तं वेधा विदधे नूनं महाभूतसमाधिना R.i.29; 4. an actual occurrence, a fact; 5. the past; 6. welfare; 7. the world; 8. the number ‘five’ (in math.).
भूत (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Become, produced, formed, R.v.34, Sis.ii.24; 2. mixed; 3. true, really happened; 4. similar, like; 5. proper, fit; 6. obtained; 7. past, gone, (pp. of भू q.v.).
भूत-अनुकंपा f. compassion towards all beings, R.ii.48.
भूत-अंतक m. an epithet of Yama.
भूत-अर्थ m. the reality, the truth, आर्ये कथयामि ते भूतार्थम् Sak.i., कः श्रद्धास्यति भूतार्थं सर्वो मां तुलयिष्यति Mrich.iii., भूतार्थव्याहृतिः सा हि न स्तुतिः परमेष्ठिनः R.x.33.
भूत-आत्मक a. composed of the elements.
भूत-आत्मन् m. 1. the individual soul, (op. to परमात्मन्); 2. body; 3. war, conflict; 4. an epithet of Brahman (m.); 5. of Śiva.
भूत-आदि m. 1. the supreme spirit; 2. an epithet of Ahankāra (in Sāṅkhya phil.).
भूत-आर्त a. possessed by a demon.
भूत-आवास m. 1. the body; 2. an epithet of Śiva; 3. of Viṣṇu.
भूत-वास m. the Bibhītaka tree.
भूत-आविष्ट a. posseated by an evil spirit.
भूत-आवेश m. demoniac possession.
भूत-इज्य a. making oblations to the Bhūtas.
भूत-इष्टा f. the fourteenth day of a Inna fortnight.
भूत-ईश m. 1. an epithet of Viṣṇu; 2. of Brahman (m.); 3. of Śiva, भूतेशस्य भुजंगवल्लिवलयस्त्रङ्नद्धजूटा जटाः M.M.i.
भूत-ईश्वर m. an epithet of Śiva, भूतेश्वरपार्श्ववर्ती R.ii.46.
भूत-उन्माद m. demoniac possession.
भूत-उपसृष्ट, -उपहत a. possessed by an evil spirit.
भूत-उपसृष्ट, -उपहत a. possessed by an evil spirit.
भूत-ओदन m. a dish of rice.
भूत-कर्तृ, -कृत् m. an epithet of Brahman (m.).
भूत-कर्तृ, -कृत् m. an epithet of Brahman (m.).
भूत-काल m. the preterite tense (in gram.).
भूत-केशी f. the white basil.
भूत-क्रांति f. possession by an evil spirit.
भूत-गण m. 1. the aggregate of all beings; 2. the whole class of demons or spirits, Bg.xvii.4.
भूत-ग्रस्त a. possessed by an evil spirit.
भूत-ग्राम m. 1. the aggregate of living beings, Bg.viii.19; 2. a class of spirits; 3. the body.
भूत-घ्न m. 1. a camel; 2. garlic.
भूत-घ्नी f. the holy basil.
भूत-चतुर्दशी f. the fourteenth day of the second half of Kārtīka.
भूत-चारिन् m. an epithet of Śiva.
भूत-जय m. victory over the elements.
भूत-दया f. universal benevolence.
भूत-धरा, -धात्री, -धारिणी f. the earth.
भूत-धरा, -धात्री, -धारिणी f. the earth.
भूत-धरा, -धात्री, -धारिणी f. the earth.
भूत-नाथ m. an epithet of Śiva.
भूत-नायिका n. an epithet of Durgā.
भूत-नाशन m. 1. mustard; 2. pepper.
भूत-निचय m. the body.
भूत-पति m. 1. an epithet of Śiva, K.S.iii.43, 74; 2. of Agni; 3. the sacred basil.
भूत-पत्नी f. the holy basil.
भूत-पूर्णिमा f. the full-moon day in the month of Āśvina.
भूत-पूर्व a. existed before, prior.
भूत-पूर्वम् ind. formerly.
भूत-प्रकृति f. the origin of all beings.
भूत-बलि m. an offering to all beings. (See भूतयज्ञ.)
भूत-ब्रह्मन् m. a low Brnhmana who subsists upon the offerings made to an idol.
भूत-भर्तृ m. an epithet of Śiva.
भूत-भावन m. 1. an epithet of Brahman (m.); 2. of Viṣṇu.
भूत-भाषा f. the language of demons.
भूत-भाषित n. the language of demons.
भूत-मय a. 1. formed out of elements; 2. including all beings.
भूत-महेश्वर m. an epithet of Śiva.
भूत-यज्ञ m. an oblation to all created beings, (भूतेभ्यो बलिहरणं भूतयज्ञः Hārīta); this is one of the five daily Yajnyas. See महायज्ञ.
भूत-योनि m. the origin of all beings.
भूत-राज् m. an epithet of Śiva.
भूत-वर्ग m. the whole class of evil beings.
भूत-वाहन m. an epithet of Śiva.
भूत-विक्रिया f. 1. epilepsy; 2. possession by evil spirits.
भूत-विज्ञान n. demonology.
भूत-विद्या f. demonology.
भूत-वृक्ष m. the Bibhītaka tree.
भूत-संसार m. the world of mortals.
भूत-संचार m. demoniac possession.
भूत-संप्लव m. universal deluge.
भूत-सर्ग m. 1. the creation of the world; 2. creation of the elements.
भूत-सूक्ष्म n. a subtle element.
भूत-स्थान n. the dwelling place of demons.
भूत-हत्या f. destruction of animal being.

भूति (I) f. 1. Being, existence; 2. birth, production; 3. dignity, majesty; 4. superhuman power obtainable by the practice of austerity; 5. ashes, स्फुटोपमं भूतिसितेन शंभुना Sis.i.4; 6. wealth, riches, fortune, विपत्प्रतीकारपरेण मंगलं निषेव्यते भूतिसमुत्सुकेन वा K.S.v.76; 7. welfare, well-being, प्रजानामेव भूत्यर्थं स ताभ्यो बलिमग्रहीत् R.i.18, ii.75; 8. decoration of elephants with coloured stripes, भक्तिच्छेदैरिव विरचितां भूतिमंगे गजस्य Megh.i.19; 9. fried meat; 10. the rutting of elephants.
भूति (II) m. 1. An epithet of Śiva; 2. of Viṣṇu.
भूति-कर्मन् n. a festive rite.
भूति-काम m. 1. a minister of state; 2. an epithet of Bṛhaspati.
भूति-काल m. a happy hour.
भूति-कील m. 1. a hole, a pit; 2. a cellar.
भूति-कृत् m. an epithet of Śiva.
भूति-गर्भ m. an epithet of Bhavabhūti.
भूति-द m. an epithet of Śiva.
भूति-निधान n. the lunar mansion Dhaniṣṭhā.
भूति-भूषण m. an epithet of Śiva.
भूति-वाहन m. an epithet of Śiva.
भूतिक n. 1. Sandal wood; 2. camphor.
